hooks.comment: Wiki quality gate on changed files (tracked + untracked). Warn-only — PostToolUse cannot block. Aggregated into one uv run to stay <500ms.
hooks.command: git status --porcelain -- wiki/ | grep -q . && uv run python scripts/lint_changed_wiki.py || true
git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q '.DS_Store' && { echo '⚠️  .DS_Store in staging area — remove before commit'; exit 1; } || true
